description: This file defines the `CustomerAttribute` entity class, which models customer attribute data in the sales management system. It includes mappings to the database table `CUSTOMER_ATTRIBUTE`, with relationships to `Customer`, `CustomerOption`, and `CustomerOptionValue` entities, and contains getter/setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: CustomerAttribute
classes.description: Entity class representing customer attributes with database mappings and relationships to customer options, values, and the customer entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the customer attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the customer attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOption
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOption associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomerOptionValue
methods.description: Sets the CustomerOptionValue for this attribute.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves the Customer associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the Customer for this attribute.

methods.name: getTextValue
methods.description: Returns the text value stored in this attribute.

methods.name: setTextValue
methods.description: Sets the text value in this attribute.
